assessments.reasoning: Event 47bca22f41744b39b938dd80de3a06bc, Mozilla archive, MPL 1.0 governing revision 1, [3290,4172). The grantor is the notice-identified Initial Developer. The seven verbs and the qualification appear together in this edition.

challenge.method: Tested whether the grant covers a contributor’s own changes, unrelated code combined in a Larger Work, or all patents needed to use a combination.
challenge.results: Section 2.2 separately addresses contributors. Section 3.7 preserves conditions on Covered Code within a Larger Work. Section 2.1(b) separately limits patent rights. None enlarges the object of §2.1(a).

limitations: Sections 1.6, 1.10 and 5 tie the developer, Original Code and application to the Exhibit A notice. The archive supplies no completed notice for a particular work.
reasoning: MPL 1.0 §2.1(a) lists all seven acts for Original Code or portions, with or without Modifications or as part of a Larger Work. The introductory language makes the grant worldwide, royalty-free, nonexclusive and subject to third-party intellectual-property claims.
